summary: Robo.ai Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 9, 2026, announcing that its Alif Holding industrial group plans to establish Alif Maritec as a wholly owned UAE subsidiary focused on marine security and intelligent maritime infrastructure across maritime protection, smart ports, underwater intelligence and critical infrastructure protection. Dr. Jasem Al-Mansory, Alif Holding CEO, is expected to serve as Chairman. No price, stake, premium or closing terms were disclosed. The filing also references prior 2026 divestiture of legacy operations, the Neurovia AI and Quantum Core Capital acquisitions, and preliminary revenue figures. This is a routine operational announcement, not a special situation.
